tldr: 台積電9月營收與Q3創高，為10/15法說鋪路，牽動權值集中的台股多空。
記憶體仍處超級循環，研調估本季DRAM、NAND合約價續漲，帶動記憶體族群。
金管會持續鬆綁壽險資金投入長照與公建，高股息ETF推升整體規模創高。
美9月CPI（週三）與月底Fed會議為本週重頭戲，IMF、世銀曼谷年會登場、全球成長估約3%。
美股結束創高的一周、公債殖利率攀抵多年高檔，美國大型銀行今日打頭陣登場財報季。
台灣遺贈稅修法重塑死亡前贈與課稅方式，稅負改由受贈人按比例負擔。

items.title_zh: 台積電Q3營收創高 10/15法說登場成風向球
items.title_en: TSMC posts record Q3 revenue ahead of its Oct 15 earnings call
items.summary_zh: 台積電9月合併營收5,118.57億元，月減0.6%、年增54.6%，創歷年同期新高、單月次高；第三季營收1兆4,942.44億元，季增17.62%，改寫單季新高並超越財測高標，前九月累計約3.90兆元、年增41.1%。台積電占大盤權重逾四成，10月15日（週四）法說會將說明AI需求、2奈米進度與明年資本支出，牽動加權指數與電子股後市多空方向，為本週市場最大焦點。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported September sales of NT$511.86bn, down 0.6% month-on-month but up 54.6% from a year earlier, a record for the month and its second-highest ever. Third-quarter revenue reached NT$1.4942tn, up 17.62% sequentially and a single-quarter high that beat its own guidance, with nine-month sales near NT$3.90tn (+41.1% y/y). Its Oct 15 results call—covering AI demand, 2nm ramp and 2027 capex—should steer the weighting-heavy index.

items.title_zh: 記憶體族群題材發酵 營運創高帶動類股
items.title_en: Memory-chip names stay in focus as the up-cycle broadens
items.summary_zh: 記憶體市場需求回溫，成為台股資金輪動焦點。先前財報顯示，南亞科單季獲利大幅回升，旺宏、威剛營運同創新高，反映供給緊俏與報價轉強。在研調機構預期合約價續漲下，投資人持續將資金轉進記憶體相關個股，與AI伺服器、晶圓代工龍頭形成互補題材，使記憶體族群成為第四季盤面較活絡的類股之一，惟漲勢能否延續仍須觀察後續報價與下游拉貨力道。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's memory sector remains a market theme as DRAM and NAND demand recovers. Earlier results showed Nanya Technology swinging to a sharp profit while Macronix and Adata hit operating highs, reflecting tight supply and firmer pricing. With research houses projecting further contract-price gains, investors continue rotating into memory-related stocks as a complement to AI-server and foundry leaders, keeping the group among the market's more active themes into the fourth quarter.

items.title_zh: 研調估本季記憶體合約價續揚 供給緊俏
items.title_en: Memory contract prices seen rising further this quarter on tight supply
items.summary_zh: 研調機構預期記憶體漲勢延續。TrendForce估本季DRAM合約價仍將季增、NAND Flash維持堅挺，AI伺服器與資料中心需求使市況維持極度緊缺，部分外資對DDR漲幅估得更高。報價持續走強，撐起台廠記憶體與模組業者的營收與毛利，惟漲幅可望較前幾季的大幅跳升趨於收斂。供給面擴產節奏與需求端拉貨力道，將是影響後續合約價走勢與相關個股評價的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Research firms expect the memory up-cycle to extend. TrendForce projects fourth-quarter DRAM contract prices still climbing sequentially while NAND Flash holds firm, as AI-server and data-center demand keeps the market extremely tight; some banks model even steeper DDR gains. The sustained pricing strength supports revenue and margins across Taiwan's memory makers and module houses, though the pace of increases is expected to moderate from the earlier, more aggressive quarterly jumps.

items.title_zh: AI伺服器出貨 鴻海市占逾四成領先廣達緯創
items.title_en: Foxconn keeps AI-server shipment lead over Quanta and Wistron
items.summary_zh: 外資通路訪查顯示，鴻海在輝達GB系列機櫃出貨市占逾44%，居台系ODM之首，領先廣達與緯創，反映雲端業者加大建置、帶動GB200與GB300系統需求。法人預期，隨機櫃出貨量放大、新世代平台陸續放量，AI伺服器產業鏈獲利可望於2026年更全面釋放，大型組裝廠續居AI資本支出浪潮的主要受惠者，惟須留意世代交替期的出貨節奏與零組件供貨調整。
items.summary_en: Foreign-broker channel checks show Foxconn holding the top share in Nvidia GB-series rack shipments, above 44%, ahead of Quanta and Wistron, as hyperscaler build-outs drive demand for GB200 and GB300 systems. Analysts expect profits across Taiwan's AI-server supply chain to be released more fully through 2026 as rack volumes scale and next-generation platforms ramp, keeping the big assemblers among the key beneficiaries of the ongoing AI capital-expenditure wave.

items.title_zh: 金管會擴大壽險投資「健康福祉事業」範疇
items.title_en: Regulator broadens insurers' scope to invest in "health and wellbeing" businesses
items.summary_zh: 金管會保險局10月6日發布令釋，取消保險業投資健康福祉事業須與保單核保、理賠、給付連結的限制，服務對象也不再僅限保戶，並即日生效；對非上市櫃健康事業的持股上限可達100%。金管會將健康福祉事業分為五大領域，涵蓋長期照顧與全齡友善服務等，引導壽險資金投入高齡化下的照顧經濟，兼顧保戶權益與監理底線，為壽險業開拓新投資與策略布局空間，業者對健康管理顧問、藥局通路與長照輔助等領域興趣濃厚。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's FSC issued an order on Oct 6 removing the requirement that insurers' investments in health-and-wellbeing businesses be tied to policy underwriting, claims or payouts, and dropping the limit confining services to policyholders; it took effect immediately. Insurers may hold up to 100% of unlisted health-business targets. The agency groups the field into five areas—including long-term care and all-ages friendly services—to channel life-insurance capital into the care economy.

items.title_zh: 壽險兆元活水入基建 擴及AI算力、冷鏈倉儲
items.title_en: Insurers' "trillion-dollar" infrastructure channel widens to AI and logistics
items.summary_zh: 修正後規定將保險業辦理專案運用、公共及社會福利事業投資的資金總額上限，由可運用資金10%提高至15%，適用範圍並擴及AI算力中心、智慧倉儲、海底電纜等新型態案源。金管會另將「AI新十大建設」納入策略性產業，保險業可投資或放款，並放寬透過私募股權基金投資公建的限額。政策方向在引導長天期壽險資金投入實體資產與公共建設，支應國內投資並兼顧資產負債管理，為壽險資金去化與收益率提供新出口。
items.summary_en: Revised rules lift the cap on insurers' capital for project, public-construction and social-welfare investments from 10% to 15% of usable funds, and extend eligible targets to new areas such as AI computing centers, smart warehousing and submarine cables. The regulator has also folded the "new ten major AI construction" projects into strategic industries that insurers may invest in or lend to, while raising private-equity-fund infrastructure limits, aiming to steer long-term insurance money into real assets.

items.title_zh: 高股息ETF 00878規模創高 配息走揚
items.title_en: High-dividend ETF 00878 pushes assets to records as payouts climb
items.summary_zh: 國泰永續高股息00878基金規模由2024年底約3,763億元，成長至2025年底逾4,602億元，1月一度突破4,700億元創成立新高。最新一期配息1.01元於9月11日發放，第二季曾配0.66元創歷史新高；該ETF為季配，除息月落在2、5、8、11月。同期整體台股ETF規模達7.859兆元、同創新高，凸顯存股族對收益型商品的強勁需求，惟殖利率係依過去配息估算，實際報酬仍隨股價波動，投資人仍須留意成分股評價與填息狀況。
items.summary_en: Cathay Sustainability High Dividend (00878) has grown from about NT$376.3bn in assets at end-2024 to over NT$460.2bn by end-2025, topping NT$470bn in January for a record. Its latest NT$1.01 distribution was paid Sept 11, and a second-quarter payout of NT$0.66 set a record; the ETF distributes quarterly in February, May, August and November. Total Taiwan equity-ETF assets have reached a record NT$7.859tn, underlining retail demand for income products.

items.title_zh: 定期定額族持續布局市值型與高息ETF
items.title_en: Regular-savings ETF investors keep rotating into income and market-cap funds
items.summary_zh: 台灣ETF定期定額戶數持續擴張，元大台灣50（0050）定期定額交易戶突破128萬戶，居市值型ETF之首，高股息如0056、00878亦維持龐大投資族群。此趨勢反映盤面震盪下，國人偏好分散、相對低波動的配置工具，市值型與高股息兩大主題持續吸引每月扣款資金，成為長期存股族的核心配置。對財富管理而言，透過定期定額平滑進場成本、搭配資產配置，有助於在高檔震盪行情中分散風險、累積部位。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's regular-savings (dollar-cost-averaging) ETF base keeps expanding, with Yuanta Taiwan Top 50 (0050) surpassing 1.28 million dollar-cost accounts, the most among market-cap ETFs, while high-dividend products such as 0056 and 00878 retain large followings. The trend reflects households favoring diversified, lower-volatility vehicles amid choppy index action, with both market-cap and dividend themes drawing steady monthly inflows as a core allocation tool for long-term savers.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅修法 死亡前贈與稅負改由受贈人負擔
items.title_en: Estate-and-gift-tax amendment shifts the tax burden to gift recipients
items.summary_zh: 立法院8月21日三讀通過遺產及贈與稅法修正，總統9月11日公布，以回應憲法法庭判決。被繼承人死亡前兩年內贈與特定親屬的財產仍併入遺產總額，但稅負改由各受贈人按比例負擔，不再由其他繼承人分攤；同時取消稅額滿30萬元才能申請分期的門檻，並調整滯納金計算（改依稅捐稽徵法，每逾3日加徵1%、最高10%）。財政部正研擬修正施行細則、申報書表及線上申辦系統，將加強宣導，影響高資產族群的傳承與贈與規劃。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's legislature passed amendments to the Estate and Gift Tax Act on Aug 21, promulgated by the president on Sept 11, responding to a Constitutional Court ruling. Property gifted to specified relatives within two years before death is still added to the estate, but the tax is now borne proportionally by each recipient rather than shared among other heirs. The change also removes the NT$300,000 threshold for applying to pay in installments and recalculates late-payment surcharges. The Finance Ministry is revising sub-regulations, forms and online filing.

items.title_zh: 2026綜所稅減稅 長照與基本生活費扣除額調高
items.title_en: 2026 income-tax relief raises long-term-care and basic-living deductions
items.summary_zh: 2026年綜所稅申報期為5月1日至6月3日，長照特別扣除額提高至18萬元，每人基本生活費調升至21.3萬元，減輕有長照需求家庭的稅負。國稅局並提醒，網紅等個人若自平台取得分潤，申報綜所稅時須列入執行業務收入（表演人）依規定申報，顯示稅局在推出減稅紅包的同時，也加強對數位經濟所得的查核，提醒民眾留意新制申報細節，以免漏報受罰。
items.summary_en: For the 2026 filing season (May 1–Jun 3), Taiwan raised the special long-term-care deduction to NT$180,000 and lifted the per-person basic living expense to NT$213,000, easing the burden on households with care needs. Authorities also reminded that online influencers receiving platform revenue-sharing must report it as professional (performer) practice income, as tax offices tighten oversight of digital-economy earnings alongside the broader relief package.

items.title_zh: 美9月CPI週三登場 為Fed決策前最後關鍵數據
items.title_en: US September CPI (Wednesday) is the last big data point before the Fed meets
items.summary_zh: 美國9月消費者物價指數將於週三（10月14日）公布，距Fed 10月27至28日的FOMC會議約兩週。市場預估整體CPI年增約3.7%、核心約2.4%，克里夫蘭聯準會即時預估分別為3.60%與2.39%，汽油被視為推升整體數字的主因。繼8月數據偏強後，市場正評估Fed按兵不動或再升息，其中核心CPI最可能左右利率押注，數據若高於預期恐升高升息疑慮，牽動美債殖利率與全球風險性資產走向，為本週最受矚目的總經事件。
items.summary_en: The September consumer price index is due Wednesday, Oct 14, roughly two weeks before the FOMC's Oct 27–28 meeting. Street consensus is for headline CPI near 3.7% and core around 2.4% year-on-year, with the Cleveland Fed nowcast at 3.60% and 2.39%; gasoline is seen as the main driver of the headline rise. After August's firmer readings, markets are weighing whether the Fed holds or hikes, with core CPI the figure most likely to move the odds.

items.title_zh: IMF、世銀曼谷年會登場 全球成長估約3%
items.title_en: IMF–World Bank annual meetings open in Bangkok with growth seen near 3%
items.summary_zh: 國際貨幣基金（IMF）與世界銀行2026年年會於曼谷舉行，IMF可望在會中更新全球經濟預測。IMF於9月簡報指出，全球經濟展現韌性，仍可望維持約3%的成長，與7月預測相近，但示警風險依舊偏高，包括油氣價格居高、全球債務壓力攀升，以及通膨回落進程停滯。這場年會為各國決策者定調，並在貿易與地緣政治不確定性仍存之際，提供全球成長與政策走向的重要風向，台灣以出口為導向，須密切關注外需動能變化。
items.summary_en: The IMF and World Bank hold their 2026 annual meetings in Bangkok, where the Fund is expected to update its global forecast. In a September briefing the IMF said the world economy has stayed resilient and remains on track for growth of around 3%, little changed from its July view, while cautioning that risks remain high—elevated oil and gas prices, mounting global debt and a stalled disinflation process. The gathering sets the tone for policymakers amid lingering trade and geopolitical uncertainty.

items.title_zh: 美股收紅、結束創高一周 公債殖利率走高（2026-10-09，最近可確認交易日）
items.title_en: US stock indexes cap a record week as Treasury yields climb (2026-10-09, latest confirmed session / 最近交易日)
items.summary_zh: 美股在最近一個可確認交易日收漲，為創高的一周作收。標普500上漲0.6%至7,811.54點，道瓊漲0.8%至51,654.95點，那斯達克綜合指數漲0.6%至27,366.17點；標普全周約漲1.2%，今年以來漲幅約14%。10年期美債殖利率升至約5.24%，逼近多年高點，在新通膨數據公布前持續壓抑利率敏感類股。市場在高檔震盪中觀望CPI與Fed動向，為後市多空關鍵。
items.summary_en: Wall Street rose in its most recent confirmed session to close out a record-setting week. The S&P 500 added 0.6% to 7,811.54, the Dow gained 0.8% to 51,654.95 and the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.6% to 27,366.17. For the week the S&P 500 climbed about 1.2%, leaving it up roughly 14% year to date. The 10-year Treasury yield pushed to around 5.24%, near multi-year highs, keeping pressure on rate-sensitive sectors ahead of fresh inflation data.

items.title_zh: 美國大型銀行打頭陣 Q3財報季開跑（2026-10-13）
items.title_en: Big US banks kick off Q3 earnings season (2026-10-13)
items.summary_zh: 摩根大通與高盛預定於10月13日（週一）美股開盤前公布第三季財報，為財報季揭開序幕。分析師普遍預期營收年增雙位數，市場聚焦交易與投資銀行業務收入、淨利息收入及成本趨勢，高盛已預告非薪酬費用將增加。金融巨頭業績是觀察美國消費與企業景氣的早期指標，將為整體財報季定調，並影響市場對美股評價與獲利動能的預期，為本週國際盤面重要焦點。
items.summary_en: JPMorgan Chase and Goldman Sachs are scheduled to report third-quarter results before the US market open on Monday, Oct 13, opening earnings season. Analysts broadly expect double-digit year-on-year revenue growth, with attention on trading and dealmaking revenue, net interest income and cost trends; Goldman has flagged higher non-compensation expenses. The results will offer an early read on the health of US consumers and corporations and help set the tone for the broader reporting season.
